integrity: Analytic determinant and Hessian arguments accompany a self-contained exact-rational verifier; numerical matrix comparison is supplementary, not a proof of the infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: The optimum is over one fixed south-pole sample and three regular rings of 3, 5, and 7 equally weighted nodes, not all 16-point designs.
The optimized quantity is the squared modulus of the complete harmonic evaluation determinant, not the condition number, Lebesgue constant, or numerical inversion error.
The six exact chamber comparisons are certified using rational arithmetic and analytic strict concavity; no simple radical expressions for the optimal heights are claimed.
Scientific priority is assessed against the available primary and published comparison literature; historical equivalence in an unlocated interpolation source is possible.
title: The globally optimal sixteen-node spherical ring determinant and its six-chamber hierarchy
